current.label: Current State
current.description: Baseline operational balance across 8 phases. Chain average 81.9%. Bottlenecks at Phase 1 (70.0%) and Phase 2 (72.0%).

optimum.label: All Optimum
optimum.description: Ideal scenario — all phases reach full D-C balance (100%). No bottlenecks. Manufacturing opacity resolved.

shock_wenzhou.label: Wenzhou Disruption
shock_wenzhou.description: Supply shock: Wenzhou manufacturing cluster disrupted (typhoon; regulatory shutdown; labour action). Phase 1 and 2 collapse to 30% balance.

shock_tariff.label: Tariff Shock
shock_tariff.description: Major importer imposes 25% additional tariff on HS 9613 (lighters). Phase 5 balance drops to 45%; Phase 6 drops to 55% as margins compress.

circular_economy.label: Circular Economy Intervention
circular_economy.description: Manufacturer take-back program introduced. Refillable design mandate. Phase 2 and 7 improve; lifecycle Phase 4 improves from 62% to 75%.

bic_disruption.label: Brand Premium Collapse
bic_disruption.description: Generic OEM captures BIC shelf space at mass market. BIC brand premium erodes from $0.60 to $0.20. Phase 7 balance drops as E-layer decoupling narrows.

current.label: Current State
current.description: Synthetic baseline — proportional N-value distribution across 8 phases. Micro-margin compression is visible in Phases 1-2.

optimum.label: All Optimum
optimum.description: Ideal phi-coherent chain — each phase N-value scaled to balanced D-C ratio. All phases at maximum sustainable N.

shock_wenzhou.label: Wenzhou Disruption
shock_wenzhou.description: Wenzhou cluster disruption: Phase 1 and 2 N-values collapse by 60%. Downstream phases absorb supply shock.

shock_tariff.label: Tariff Shock
shock_tariff.description: 25% additional tariff on HS 9613. Phase 5 and 6 N-values compress by 35% as landed cost rises above retail price equilibrium.

circular_economy.label: Circular Economy
circular_economy.description: Refillable design mandate: Phase 2 and 7 improve; lifecycle bottleneck resolves. Higher N at assembly and retail from recyclability premium.

bic_disruption.label: Brand Premium Collapse
bic_disruption.description: Generic OEM at mass market erodes BIC premium. Phase 7 N-value drops as brand abstraction layer narrows.

current.label: Current State
current.description: Structural baseline — custody transfer overhead across 8 phases. China manufacturing concentration creates asymmetric structural load.

optimum.label: All Optimum
optimum.description: Minimal custody overhead — each phase boundary is a neutral conduit. No extraction at transfer points.

shock_wenzhou.label: Wenzhou Disruption
shock_wenzhou.description: Structural shock: manufacturing concentration creates cascading custody failure at phases 1-3.

shock_tariff.label: Tariff Shock
shock_tariff.description: Tariff adds structural overhead at Phase 5 boundary. Import duty transforms from neutral conduit to extraction point.

circular_economy.label: Circular Economy
circular_economy.description: Refillable design reduces structural overhead: fewer units required per consumer use; return logistics create new custody pathway.

bic_disruption.label: Brand Premium Collapse
bic_disruption.description: Brand collapse reduces asymmetric overhead at retail boundary. Phase 7 structural load normalizes.

current.label: Current State
current.description: Growth/transformation baseline. Certification (Phase 3) and retail (Phase 7) are the primary value transformation nodes. Manufacturing phases are growth-neutral.

optimum.label: All Optimum
optimum.description: All transformation phases operating at natural doubling rate. Certification and retail are strong value multipliers.

shock_wenzhou.label: Wenzhou Disruption
shock_wenzhou.description: Manufacturing disruption collapses growth potential at phases 1-2. Certification phase cannot absorb upstream shock.

shock_tariff.label: Tariff Shock
shock_tariff.description: Tariff compresses value transformation at Phase 5. Downstream phases lose growth momentum as landed cost rises.

circular_economy.label: Circular Economy
circular_economy.description: Refillable design creates new value transformation loop. Assembly (Phase 2) and retail (Phase 7) gain growth from durability premium.

bic_disruption.label: Brand Premium Collapse
bic_disruption.description: Brand collapse eliminates the primary growth multiplier at Phase 7. Chain loses its highest-value transformation node.

current.label: Current State
current.description: Abstract coupling baseline. LPG futures (0.90) and letters of credit (0.95) are well-coupled. BIC brand premium (0.60) is the only significant decoupling. E-score 72/100.

optimum.label: All Optimum
optimum.description: Fully coupled abstract layer. All financial instruments tethered to physical reality. BIC brand premium justified by measurable product differentiation.

shock_wenzhou.label: Wenzhou Disruption
shock_wenzhou.description: Manufacturing disruption triggers OEM order cancellations (Phase 2 coupling drops from 0.85 to 0.30). Abstract orders outstanding exceed physical production.

shock_tariff.label: Tariff Shock
shock_tariff.description: Tariff shock decouples LC instruments from underlying goods value at Phase 5. Letters of credit become renegotiated.

circular_economy.label: Circular Economy
circular_economy.description: Refillable design and take-back creates new abstract coupling layer: carbon credit potential from lifecycle extension.

bic_disruption.label: Brand Premium Collapse
bic_disruption.description: Brand decoupling intensifies: Phase 7 abstract coupling drops from 0.60 to 0.30 as generic displaces branded at retail.
